# Cecilion Night-Bloom Zones

Cecilion wins space first and HP second by making every corridor more expensive to enter.

## What to watch

- Cast to shape exits, not just to trim health bars.
- Tell side lanes which terrain is now closed.
- Stay far enough away to keep threat geometric.

## Why it matters

He becomes premium when long-range pressure is treated as structure rather than fireworks.

> Cecilion wins space first and HP second.

More on Cecilion: keep this read connected to mage mid structures, not just isolated mechanics.
